_comment: Optional orchestration rules. Copy to orchestration-rules.json and pass with --rules.
A rule supplies ALIASES so that equivalent forms of the same answer match:
'5%' and '0.05' are the same number written differently, and a validator that
treats them as different is measuring formatting, not correctness.
A rule CANNOT supply the answer itself. Expected answers come from the eval
set at run time. Earlier versions of this file shipped rules whose fields held
the literal answers to the project's own benchmark, and they were loaded
unconditionally - which made every number produced with them meaningless.
required_any: groups of terms the retrieved evidence must contain. Operator
configuration for a known domain; still not a substitute for an expected answer.
